meta_description:
524K likes, 817 comments - mrunalthakur on October 10, 2026: "Happiest birthday to my first baby, my partner in crime, my forever little boy. 🥹❤️

You’ve taught me patience… shown me what hard work looks like, and reminded me what strength truly means. You’re the coolest, smartest kid I know….. but more than anything you have the kindest soul and the most beautiful heart Omi 

Sometimes I wonder how I got so lucky to have you as my brother. If life gave me a million chances I would  choose to be your sister in every single one of them.

You may have grown up, but you’ll always be my baby, the one I’ll worry about, pray for, be proud of, and love a little extra, no matter how old we get hehe

I love you to the moon and back Oma !
You’ll never know how much of my heart you hold. Happiest birthday, my world. 🧿❤️

 I NUV YOU 3000 🌻🌻🌻🌻🌻🌻🌻🌻🌻🎈🎈🎈🎈🎈🎈🎈🎈🎈🎈🎈🎈🎈".
